against.head: Uptrend broken: under its last swing low
against.learn: When price closes under the last swing low, the run of higher lows ends.
against.text: The swings had been climbing, but price has closed under the last swing low (Sep 14): the run of higher lows is broken.

against.head: Broke down from a 9-week base
against.learn: A close below a floor that held before.
against.text: It closed below the bottom of a 9-week base on 1.1x average volume.

against.head: The trigger failed before
against.learn: A line price closed above and then gave back has failed once already; the next break has to hold to count.
against.text: It closed above this line once since Sep 21 and gave it back .

MU.change: A close back under +6.5% after the breakout marks it failed; a daily close below −3.8% ends it.

fear.label: Fear day: Fri Oct 16
fear.text: Fri Oct 16: QQQ and MU both closed red, the kind of day the desk's fear-day rule buys.

MU.gist: A stock in an uptrend below resistance (the Jul 31 high); a daily close above it starts the move.

why: it has closed under its last swing low

plan.sentence: Buy on a daily close above +6.5% from the Oct 16 close, up to +8.4%. Target +23%. Once in, out on a daily close below −3.8%.
plan.why_t1: the Sep 25 high, past the sellers at the most-traded price of six months

standouts.head: Weekly chart: advancing
standouts.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; the advancing stage (above a rising 30-week average) is where longs pay.
standouts.text: On the weekly chart price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.

standouts.head: Support −6.8% below
standouts.learn: A price area where buyers stepped in before.
standouts.text: The nearest floor is −6.8% below (1.2 ATR): the May breakout level, the Jul 17 low and the May 13 high.

standouts.head: Quiet selling on the dip
standouts.learn: A dip on light volume is profit-taking; a dip on heavy volume is selling.
standouts.text: Volume on the current pullback runs 15% below its 50-day average: profit-taking, not an exit.

MU.take: MU: it is pulling back inside an uptrend, below resistance at the Jul 31 high; the buy waits for a daily close above it. The weekly chart is in its advancing stage, and support sits 6.8% below. Against it, it broke down from a 9-week base. The desk stays out until the trigger proves the turn.

against.head: A bearish engulfing day
against.learn: A session whose body swallows the one before: one side took the day back in full.
against.text: On Oct 16 it opened over the prior close and closed under the prior open: sellers took the day back in full.

against.head: Buying is losing force
against.learn: Price makes a higher high but momentum makes a lower high: buyers are tiring.
against.text: Price made a higher high on Oct 13 while RSI, MACD and CCI made a lower high (regular bearish divergence).

MSFT.change: A daily close below −4.9%, under the Oct 14, 2025 low, proves it wrong. So would heavy selling into the buy zone.

fear.text: Fri Oct 16: QQQ and MSFT both closed red, the kind of day the desk's fear-day rule buys.

MSFT.gist: A stock in an uptrend; the buy is lower, at support (the November 2025 breakout level and the Nov 13, 2025 high); momentum holds a bull range.

plan.sentence: Buy on a pullback to between −1.3% and −3.3% from the Oct 16 close. Target +3.7%, then +8.8%. Out on a daily close below −4.9%.
plan.why_t1: the 52-week high and the Oct 28, 2025 high
plan.why_zone: the November 2025 breakout level, the Nov 13, 2025 high and the 20-day average

standouts.head: Uptrend on every average
standouts.learn: Higher highs and higher lows, with price above rising averages.
standouts.text: Price is above its rising 50-day and 200-day averages, and the 50-day is above the 200-day.

standouts.head: Support −1.7% below
standouts.learn: A price area where buyers stepped in before.
standouts.text: The nearest floor is −1.7% below (0.7 ATR): the November 2025 breakout level, the Nov 13, 2025 high and the 20-day average.

standouts.head: Momentum holding a bull range
standouts.learn: In uptrends RSI tends to hold 40 on dips and reach 70; in downtrends it fails near 60 and reaches 30.
standouts.text: RSI has stayed above 45 on every dip for three months and reached 79: the range momentum holds in an uptrend.

standouts.head: In a 3-week base
standouts.learn: A sideways range after a move, where the stock rests before its next leg.
standouts.text: It has moved sideways for 3 weeks in a range 11% deep after a +44% advance.

standouts.head: Buyers control the volume
standouts.learn: Volume on up days against volume on down days; above 1 means buyers trade more.
standouts.text: Over ten weeks, volume on up days is 1.4x the volume on down days.

MSFT.take: MSFT: it is in an uptrend on every average. Resistance +4% overhead leaves too little room from here. The better price is lower, at the November 2025 breakout level and the Nov 13, 2025 high. Momentum holds a bull range, and it is in a 3-week base. Against it, buying is losing force. This is the kind of setup the desk wants to own.
